name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single high-contrast skip link at the very top of every page that jumps directly to the main content area. This solves the biggest keyboard navigation pain point—traversing repetitive headers and navigation menus—without cluttering the interface. The trade-off is one extra click for mouse users, but the benefit for keyboard and screen-reader users is immediate and universal.

name: Reader
text: The risk with a single skip link is that it may not be effective on pages with multiple distinct navigation sections, which could lead to further keyboard navigation issues. A better alternative might be to implement a more dynamic skip link system that can adapt to varying page structures, such as a "skip to main content" link that only appears when the main content area is not immediately focusable. This argument could be settled by testing the proposed skip link solution on a representative sample of pages with complex navigation and evaluating its effectiveness for keyboard users.
